name: Fhase 87 and Chich at Gare
description: The city's premier underground venue delivers another top-tier techno lineup, perfect for those seeking an authentic and immersive clubbing experience.
longDescription:
On August 7, 2026, Gare Porto hosts a techno event featuring Fhase 87 and Chich. This nightlife offering presents a lineup focused on electronic music, consistent with Gare's programming as a prominent underground venue in Porto. The event is designed for those interested in a focused clubbing experience with established and emerging artists in the techno genre.

Attendees can expect an immersive atmosphere within Gare Porto, known for its industrial aesthetic and sound system. The venue typically draws an audience interested in electronic music and late-night events. The experience is characterized by extended DJ sets and a focus on the music itself, providing a setting for dancing and engaging with the sound.

This is a ticketed event. Further details regarding ticket availability and purchase methods will be announced closer to the date. Gare Porto is located near the São Bento train station, accessible via the São Bento metro station (line D) and various bus routes. It is within walking distance of central Porto.
